title: Pinki Singh v. State of U.P. And 3 Others
coram: Ashwani Kumar Mishra, J.; Donadi Ramesh, J.
disposition: Petitioner permitted to object under clause 6.5; restoration to be considered.
headnote: A consumer whose connection was disconnected on demand notices was permitted to raise a clause 6.5 objection to the demand and assessment orders before the second respondent; a reasoned order was to follow, and the plea of restoration was only to be considered.
facts: Pinki Singh's electricity connection was disconnected on demand notices for supply of electricity. She claimed she had already deposited various amounts and was willing to pay the balance if the connection were restored. The respondents submitted that her remedy was to approach the competent forum under clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Earlier listings on 25 February and 5 March 2025 had only adjourned the writ as fresh.

holding_units.holding: A consumer aggrieved by demand and assessment orders on which the connection has been disconnected may be relegated to raise an objection before the competent authority under clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, with supporting material; the authority is to examine the claim and pass a reasoned order, and the plea of restoration of connection is also to be considered.

not_decided.point: Validity of the demand notices and assessment orders, and whether the connection must be restored
not_decided.note: Writ not decided on merits; petitioner directed to object under clause 6.5, with restoration only to be considered.
